title: Wandrd’s Magnetic Camera Straps Are My New Favorite Accessory

claims.claim: Wandrd launched its Magnetic Camera Strap system on Thursday.

evidence.quote: Wandrd—known for its camera bags—launched its Magnetic Camera Strap system on Thursday.
“We're photographers ourselves, so we're constantly ideating, tinkering, thinking of ways that things can be better,” Ryan Cope, Wandrd cofounder, tells WIRED.

claims.claim: Torus Links anchors are rated to carry up to 198 pounds.

evidence.quote: The anchors attach to your camera’s eyelets and are rated to carry up to 198 pounds—so unless you're bench-pressing your camera, they'll do the job.
(Wandrd offers a two-year warranty.)

claims.claim: Wandrd's DIY kit is sold for 29 dollars.

evidence.quote: If you have a strap you love—maybe a fancy leather strap someone gifted you—Wandrd is selling a DIY kit ($29) that lets you attach its Magnetic CoreLock system to the ends of your preferred strap.

claims.claim: The strap kit comes in a 30-mm size priced at 69 dollars.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, the strap kit comes in a 30-mm size ($69), a 15-mm “Lite
